svg.text: 18-pin external I/O — fuse/power end at pin 1, endstop end at pin 18
RP2040-Plus / TMC5160T Plus component placement — top side
RP2040-Plus + BTT TMC5160T Plus Y concept review
TOP / COMPONENT SIDE: insert the shown parts here; wire-wrap conductors are omitted.
Pico USB exits above the aligned top edge; keep that entire edge clear.
Then flip the board and use rp2040plus_btt_tmc5160t_plus_y_bottom.svg for wrapping.
Diodes: K is the cathode/band. U1/U2: align the notch and pin-1 marker.
Q1: C/B/E are shown; verify the actual BC327 flat-side lead order before insertion.
U3: numbered TO-92 leads use the received UTC part's pinout:
pin 1=OUT at A13, pin 2=GND at A12, pin 3=IN at A11.
C1 is polarized: positive to A01 TMC_VIO and negative to A20 GND.
HV socket: leave positions 5 and 16 empty as the detector guard row.
Socket B: DZ2 is at row 9 and R23 is at the bottom row 10.
